'''Orias''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[General/Legends|general]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Battle of Ilum]] in [[3640 BBY]] he asked a Republic citizen to retrieve energy shields stolen by the Imperial forces.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
General Orias appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC on Ilum, who begins the mission "A Fair Fight."
